alt: Wine comparison: Qwen alone, Qwen followed by Jev, Jev alone, and logistic regression trained on the same twelve examples.
TREC decision changes: three corrected mistakes and twenty-four correct answers overturned, reducing the correct total from 194 to 173.
Accuracy change after Jev review for all forty-eight source, dataset and example-setting combinations.
Difference in Jev accuracy with a real Qwen3 proposal versus no proposal, with uncertainty ranges for all four datasets.
Jev standalone zero-shot versus four examples per class on the four datasets.
Matched-label comparison across numerical and text tasks, including Jev, Astra and all four classical classifiers.
API cost and accuracy for Jev alone, Astra alone, and Astra followed by Jev on the same two hundred TREC questions.
